q: are the visible tombs the real graves
a: A cenotaph is a memorial rather than the actual burial. My upper chamber has memorial cenotaphs; the actual graves are in a lower chamber.

q: what are the flowers on the walls
a: Craftspeople fitted carefully cut colored stones into marble to create floral designs. This decorative inlay technique is often called pietra dura or parchin kari.

q: what is the writing on the walls
a: Arabic calligraphy, including passages from the Quran, forms part of my decoration. The lettering is an important element of the architectural design.
